entries.title: MFP: My Friend Pedro
entries.definitive_edition: MFP: My Friend Pedro in a web browser

emulation.notes: Use a current browser host that still supports the game; the original was built for the Flash era.

primary.why: The browser version is the only sourced release route for the 2014 Flash-era original that inspired the later commercial game. Current web hosts keep the short original accessible, while the 2019 My Friend Pedro is represented as a separate full game entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play the browser version through a current host such as Newgrounds or Armor Games; expect a short Flash-era prototype-style game rather than the 2019 commercial release.

all_releases.fidelity: Original free web game, historically Flash-based and currently hosted through browser portals.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release route for the original game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The 2019 commercial game is a separate expanded release, not a patch or port of this short browser original.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this Flash-era original with the 2019 Devolver release.

entries.title: My Friend Pedro: Arena
entries.definitive_edition: My Friend Pedro: Arena in a web browser

emulation.notes: Use a current browser host that still supports the game.

primary.why: The browser version is the only sourced release route for the Arena follow-up, which puts the original My Friend Pedro mechanics into score/survival arenas.
primary.how_to_play: Play My Friend Pedro: Arena through Newgrounds or Armor Games in a browser; treat it as a short web spin-off rather than the 2019 full game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform release is documented for this browser spin-off.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an arena-style web spin-off, not the 2019 commercial game.

entries.title: My Friend Pedro
entries.definitive_edition: My Friend Pedro on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route for the full commercial game because it has native PC capture/settings flexibility and no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented for the console ports.
primary.how_to_play: Buy My Friend Pedro on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

all_releases.reason: primary: complete route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: portable access route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: console access route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: console access route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented among the PC and console releases.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2014 web original and Ripe for Revenge mobile spin-off are separate entries.

entries.title: My Friend Pedro: Ripe for Revenge
entries.definitive_edition: My Friend Pedro: Ripe for Revenge on Android

emulation.notes: For streaming capture, Android hardware capture or an Android emulator is the most practical route.

primary.why: The Android version is the best archive route for the mobile spin-off because it has a current Google Play listing, is easier to capture through Android device/emulator workflows, and has no sourced gameplay-content difference from iOS.
primary.how_to_play: Install My Friend Pedro: Ripe for Revenge from Google Play on Android, or use the iOS App Store version if that is the available device route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native mobile release with current Google Play availability.
all_releases.reason: primary: easiest mobile capture route and same sourced content as iOS.
skip: same mobile content family; Android is easier to route for capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No gameplay-content difference is sourced between Android and iOS releases.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a mobile spin-off, not a port of the 2019 full game.
